brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 is on the build; drawer:0#0,0#cut was removed. With the drawer on half-n base piece:0,0,0;half-n, addSpike at the same junction is refused SPIKE_CLASH (drawer occupies that corner); with the spike on, no drawer socket is offered. Configurator rule forbids both touching at the very same corner.
